==English==
{{wp|<dab!>}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|gambal||obsolete}}

===Etymology===
From earlier {{m|en|gamel}}, from {{inh|en|enm|*gamlen}}, {{m|enm|*gamelen}}, variant of {{der|en|enm|gamenen}}, from {{der|en|ang|gæmnian}}, {{m|ang|gamnian}}, {{m|ang|gamenian||to joke; play}}, related to Old English {{m|ang|gamen||joy; mirth; pleasure; entertainment; pastime; sport; game}}, equivalent to {{suffix|en|game|le}}. Compare {{cog|gmq-oda|gammel}}, {{cog|gmh|gamel||pleasure; fun}}. More at {{l|en|game}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɡæm.bəl/|a=UK,US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-gamble.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|æmbəl|s=2}}
* {{homophones|en|gambol}}
* {{hyph|en|gam|ble}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[bet]] or [[wager]].
#: {{ux|en|I had a '''gamble''' on the horses last weekend.}}
# A significant [[risk]], undertaken with a potential gain.
# A risky [[venture]].
#: {{ux|en|The sailors had taken many '''gambles''' with the sea and always won.}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[take a risk]], with the potential of a positive outcome.
# To play risky [[game]]s, especially [[casino]] games, for monetary gain.
#: {{syn|en|game}}
#: {{ux|en|Mark won half a million dollars '''gambling''' on horses.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[risk]] (something) for potential gain.
#: {{ux|en|He '''gambled''' his reputation on the outcome.}}
# To interact with equipment at a [[casino]].
